evidence_plan.requirement: Different correlations from different ROUGE variants
Specific ROUGE variants and their correlations

payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about the correlations resulting from different ROUGE variants and their effectiveness in evaluating summaries.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in very different correlations with manual Pyramid scores.
Among all variants, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 are better correlated with manual judgments in scientific summarization.
Keyword-based reduction variants have high correlation with ROUGE, while others show significant variance in reliability.
ROUGE is not very reliable for evaluating scientific summaries, especially with high terminology variations.
